title: Cloud Impact bundle: 15 June 2024 and season aggregates (illustrative historical valuation)
built_from: the frozen study outputs listed under input_sha256 (no runtime data access)
methodology: configs/economic_impact/prereg.yaml (pre-registered before any valuation; see its publication note); reports/economic_impact/methodology.md

definitions.plant: the explicit 6 MW 33 kV PV plant ECR:955 (Leighton Buzzard), the only PV changed in the counterfactuals
definitions.fleet_pv: all 2024 PV assets of the study area (8.945 MW), satellite-derived; shown for context only
definitions.clear_sky: the plant at its clear-sky estimate (same pvlib chain, Ineichen); everything else unchanged
definitions.no_plant: the plant's output set to 0; everything else unchanged
definitions.energy: MW difference x 0.5 h per settlement period; each AC state stands for its period
definitions.value: energy x the APX Market Index price of the same period (GBP); illustrative, not a realised saving, cost, bill or revenue

sources.name: Elexon Insights Market Index Data (APXMIDP)
